name: OpenBao CLI
description: Installs the OpenBao CLI (https://openbao.org), the open-source Vault fork, as a release binary at /usr/local/bin/bao, verified against the release's checksums.txt. Owns the login state as a named volume at OPENBAO_STATE_DIR=/var/lib/devcontainer-features/openbao (bao's token helper, set through BAO_CONFIG_PATH, keeps the token in it) so `bao login` survives rebuilds, with the post-create hook openbao-setup, and installs dcf-secret, the one command the collection's Features use to read and write secrets (get, put, status, with fixed exit codes). Set BAO_ADDR in containerEnv to point it at your server.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).

mode.description: How the Feature is used. Only 'client' exists in this version: the bao CLI and dcf-secret against a server outside the container (BAO_ADDR). Override per container with OPENBAO_SETUP_MODE in containerEnv.

version.description: OpenBao release to install (e.g. '2.7.1', with or without a leading 'v'), or 'latest'. Match your OpenBao server's version.
